text:
Lina Gomez: small visual request for Launch Studio 1"need a 'Bench Mini Kit' for the webinar promo: 1) single-page PDF (US letter) with a compact benchmark chart + 3-step lead routing diagram, 2) two social headers (1200x628 and 800x800) — one data-forward, one exec-friendly, 3) a hero image (1400x788) for landing. Brand-safe colors only. Deadline: Fri 1pm PT.
Tom Brewster: got it. quick Q on the benchmark chart: prefer overlay with dual axes or split mini-sparklines?
Lina Gomez: overlay if legible; otherwise two tiny sparklines side-by-side. Data to use: latency_ms=[38,46,55,66,79], cost_per_1k=[0.45,0.33,0.24,0.15,0.09].
Nadia Patel: noted. I'll try overlay first. For the exec header, do you want plain bullets + CTA?
Lina Gomez: exec = 3 bullets (impact statements) + big CTA button. tech = callouts for batching / quantization + mini table of top-3 model picks and per-1k token cost.
Tom Brewster: filenames I'll stage: studio_bench_onepager_v1.pdf, studio_social_1200x628_data.png, studio_social_800x800_exec.png, studio_hero_1400x788.jpg. Source Figma: /brand/marketing/launch-studio/bench-mini-kit.
brand-bot: Brand checklist Reminder - Palette: REDWOOD-500 #B91C1C + neutrals only. Typefaces: Inter (body), GT Aligned (headings). Max 2 typefaces. Text contrast >= 4.5:1. Export @2x PNG/JPG and provide SVGs for diagrams. See https://brand/redwood-guidelines (internal).
Jordan Li: ops note: registration form must POST hidden fields: campaign=launch_studio_bench, source=webinar, lead_tag=studio_bench. When lead_score>=75 -> owner_pool=bench_sales; default lead_priority=low. I'll sync mapping to ops after assets are live.
Nadia Patel: alt text for the chart (short): "Sparkline showing latency rising from 38ms to 79ms while per-1k token cost falls from $0.45 to $0.09 across model variants." (under 250 chars)
Tom Brewster: can do accessible PDF tagging and include longer description in the metadata. Also will add a tiny 3-step horizontal flow (icons + labels): Register -> Ops qualify -> Book demo. Mono-line icons, SVG included.
Lina Gomez: add footer copy: "© Redwood Inference 2026  Internal benchmark summary - do not republish." Keep legal minimal.
Tom Brewster: timeline: first comps by Thu EOD, review Fri morning, final exports Fri 1pm PT. I'll @Lina when drafts are up.
Jordan Li: FYI Sales wants an extra tag lead_priority=medium for any registrant who attends the webinar. We'll update ops mapping accordingly.
Lina Gomez: perfect, thanks team. Please keep visuals lean and brand-safe. :sparkles:
